The '''1967 FA Charity Shield''' was the 45th [[FA Community Shield|FA Charity Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match held between the winners of the previous season's [[The Football League|Football League]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was contested by [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], who had won the [[The Football League 1966–67|1966–67 Football League]], and [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]], who had won the [[FA Cup 1966–67|1966–67 FA Cup]], at [[Old Trafford]], [[Manchester]],<ref>{{cite web|title=The Shield – A brief history|url=http://www.thefa.com/TheFACup/FACompetitions/TheFACommunityShield/History.aspx|work=The FA Cup & Competitions|publisher=TheFA.com|access-date=7 February 2011}}</ref>  on 12 August 1967. The match was drawn 3–3, which meant that the two clubs shared the Shield, holding it for six months each. [[Bobby Charlton]] scored two goals for United, while [[Denis Law]] scored their third. [[Jimmy Robertson (footballer born 1944)|Jimmy Robertson]] and [[Frank Saul (footballer)|Frank Saul]] scored for Spurs, but the match is most famous for Tottenham's second goal, which was scored by goalkeeper [[Pat Jennings]]. Ball in hand, Jennings punted it downfield, only for it to bounce in front of United goalkeeper [[Alex Stepney]], over his head and into the goal.
